A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nonlinear model is a more accurate metric for phase noise and jitter prediction in the presence of strong noise, and that the nonlinear model simplifies into the well-known LTV metric for low-power noise.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the oscillator considered here, the LTV model overestimates the oscillator phase noise by a factor of 3 to 5 in the presence of a large amount of noise on the P/G rails.
the nonlinear model provides a more accurate prediction for the oscillator phase noise in the presence of large power noise.
, for a given phase noise, the oscillator's jitter increases with increasing power of noise, which has important consequences for jitter budgets.
